scope: Post-open geometry-only mechanism attribution on the same thirteen supplied nine-camera calibrations and thirteen virtual-ring nine-camera rigs already opened by v208-v210. It reads no density, observation, reconstruction, residual, parent metric array, or reference field and is not a fresh external gate.
scientific_question: Does a fixed local spatial ray-coverage floor, rather than the overlapping v210 global low-mode spectral floor, strictly distinguish every virtual-ring nine-camera geometry that passed the frozen reference gate from every supplied nine-camera calibration that failed it?

supplied_nine_failing.reference_outcome: 0/13 complete calibration groups at the frozen zero-start CGLS K16 reference gate in v208
supplied_nine_failing.coordinate_contract: Use the supplied calibrated forward coordinates: array axes map to world x,y,z with shape 32x16x16 and bounds [-20,50]x[-20,50]x[-35,35].

virtual_ring_nine_passing.reference_outcome: 13/13 complete rig groups at the same reference gate in v209
virtual_ring_nine_passing.coordinate_contract: Use the frozen virtual forward coordinates: array axes map to world z,y,x with shape 32x16x16 and world bounds [-1,1]^3.

fixed_local_ray_quadrature.active_ray_rule: Represent every reported detector ray as an infinite line and retain its unique segment inside the declared axis-aligned reconstruction box. Parallel outside lines are rejected; endpoint ties use the closed box with float64 arithmetic.
fixed_local_ray_quadrature.quadrature: Use the 64 equal-length open midpoint samples of the clipped segment. Each sample carries segment_length/64 and is deposited to the eight enclosing grid nodes by ordinary trilinear weights.
fixed_local_ray_quadrature.camera_weighting: Within each camera, sum all active-ray deposits and divide by that camera's total deposited path mass. Average the resulting tensors over active cameras, so each camera has equal total weight regardless of detector resolution or active-ray count.
fixed_local_ray_quadrature.local_tensor: At every grid node, each deposited path mass from unit direction d contributes mass*(I-d*d^T).
fixed_local_ray_quadrature.interior_support: Use exactly the one-node-shell-excluded 30x14x14 interior, for 5880 local tensors.
fixed_local_ray_quadrature.normalization: Divide every interior tensor by the mean interior trace, which must be positive and finite. No geometry-family or rig-specific fitted parameter is permitted beyond this deterministic scale removal.
fixed_local_ray_quadrature.camera_permutation: Canonicalize rays by camera id and then by float64 line point and direction bytes before accumulation. Reversing the camera roster must leave all metrics within 1e-12.

unique_primary.name: normalized_local_transverse_floor_p10_higher
unique_primary.local_value: The smallest nonnegative eigenvalue of each normalized symmetric 3x3 interior tensor. Values below -1e-12 invalidate execution; values in [-1e-12,0) are clipped to zero.
unique_primary.tail: Sort all 5880 local values and select index ceil(0.10*(5880-1)), equivalent to NumPy quantile 0.10 with method=higher.
unique_primary.strict_separation_gate: The minimum primary over all 13 virtual-ring nine-camera rigs must be strictly greater than the maximum primary over all 13 supplied nine-camera calibrations. Equivalently, all 169 cross-family comparisons must be strict wins.

preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.normalized_local_trace_p10_higher: The same fixed lower-tail statistic applied to normalized local tensor traces.
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.positive_local_transverse_fraction: Fraction of interior local minimum eigenvalues strictly greater than 1e-12.
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.normalized_local_transverse_condition_p9: Upper 90 percent tail of local largest-eigenvalue divided by max(local smallest-eigenvalue,3*machine epsilon).
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.virtual_twelve_camera_metrics: Cardinality diagnostic only and never a replacement primary.

execution_contract.offline_geometry_ray_samples: 64 times the independently reported active-ray count for each geometry

independent_validation.implementation: A second program may import frozen geometry builders but must not import the formal v211 runner. It must independently parse/reconstruct every line, use a separately written clipping and trilinear scatter implementation, rebuild all 39 local tensor fields and metrics, verify camera reversal, and confirm formal arrays and sealed inputs are unchanged.

decision_order: Any parent mismatch, source/input drift, prohibited scientific-array read, invalid line clip, non-finite tensor, negative-eigenvalue violation, missing interior support, camera-permutation failure, formal-independent mismatch, or output mutation gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_LOCAL_RAY_COVERAGE_EXECUTION_V211.

If all 169 virtual-nine versus supplied-nine primary comparisons are strict wins, conclude PASS_LOCAL_RAY_COVERAGE_STRICTLY_SEPARATES_CASE5_REFERENCE_V211. This is geometry-mechanism evidence on already opened synthetic data only.

Otherwise, if the virtual-nine primary median is strictly greater and pairwise superiority exceeds 0.5, conclude PARTIAL_OVERLAPPING_LOCAL_RAY_COVERAGE_EVIDENCE_V211 and close this scalar local-coverage explanation as an adequacy classifier.
Otherwise conclude FAIL_LOCAL_RAY_COVERAGE_DOES_NOT_EXPLAIN_CASE5_REFERENCE_V211 and close this scalar local-coverage explanation.

Diagnostics and virtual-twelve results may never replace the unique primary or upgrade a partial/negative result. No threshold, quantile, quadrature, normalization, coordinate map, or local tensor formula may be changed after observing results.
